pages.lesson:
LESSON: RAISING LAZARUS FROM THE DEAD

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.5: Raising Lazarus from the Dead

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Raising Lazarus from the Dead
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why did Jesus say that Lazarus was only asleep?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the miracle of raising Lazarus from the dead
2. appreciate God’s power over sickness and death

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the miracle of raising Lazarus from the dead

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe the miracle of raising Lazarus from the dead.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “describe the miracle of raising Lazarus from the dead” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe the miracle of raising Lazarus from the dead” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe the miracle of raising Lazarus from the dead" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate God’s power over sickness and death

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate God’s power over sickness and death.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate God’s power over sickness and death” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate God’s power over sickness and death” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate God’s power over sickness and death" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the miracle of raising Lazarus from the dead
• Model 2: appreciate God’s power over sickness and death

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the miracle of raising Lazarus from the dead
2. Practise: appreciate God’s power over sickness and death

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Raising Lazarus from the Dead.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why did Jesus say that Lazarus was only asleep?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the miracle of raising Lazarus from the dead
• appreciate God’s power over sickness and death

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
